metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the catch, a morning at the board, the three breaths, and the line on the tables.

yesterday: You caught the one eloquence at first light and left it on the sheet so you could see it.
The morning was the board's, from first light. Two of the clock was the house's play.
York's breath runs short. Gaunt's runs long. The King's never runs out. The sheet is cleaner at the end than at the start.
On the tables: not all of them may sing. You wrote nothing under the line.
The almanac prints a new moon and no hour. Kemp has not seen the page.
